verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports Triggers and SLO-based alerting with routing to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or custom webhooks, covering routing and notification delivery for any telemetry signal ingested via OTLP. However, the evidence pack does not document explicit grouping/deduplication of alerts or silencing/mute capabilities for notifications. missing for 10: documented alert grouping/deduplication logic, explicit silencing/muting controls, independent corroboration of alerting reliability in production incidents.
